newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stock flat on Hong Kong holiday.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stock flat on Hong Kong holiday.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks are seen opening flat and trading in a tight range, subdued by a holiday in Hong Kong and after a correction which began last week, brokers said.
"The holiday in Hong Kong, Colombo's largest foreign investment destination, is coming on top of the correction which began last week," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of brokerage John Keells.
On Friday the all share index closed 2.7 points down at 793.3, on turnover of 76.6 million rupees.
The market began correcting on Thursday, following six days of gains when the index rose over 30 points. Colombo stocks have gained over 30 percent in 1997, on improved investor sentiment.
